title: 18-Year-Old Islamic State Supporter in Vienna, Austria, Reportedly Sought and Received Explosives Advice From ChatGPT Amid Disputed Embassy and Mosque Attack Allegations
summary: An 18-year-old Islamic State supporter in Vienna, Austria, reportedly sought and received explosives advice from ChatGPT amid allegations of plans to attack the Israeli embassy and a Shiite Islamic center. He was convicted of terrorist association, threats, and coercion. The court acquitted him of terrorist training and instruction charges and found no evidence of preparations for a specific crime.
